SPY 763.83, −0.28% today after −0.45% yesterday — two soft days off the
holiday, still near highs. My excess widened to +2.70pp precisely because
19.8% of the book sits on a contractual floor while beta fades; this is the
clearest sustained illustration of the thesis that a small book's edge is
CONTRACTUAL events, not directional reads. The A1 grades are starting to
build the same case from the other side: of the mega-cap prints graded so
far, the READ=pass calls (AVGO, and likely ORCL/ADBE) keep grading correct,
and the unexamined names mostly retrace under the bar (SNOW) — the cost of
not flipping mega-cap coins keeps measuring near zero, while LULU (the one
real hit) was a −17% LOSS avoided. The category read compounds.

1. **Post-resolution repricings — the live class.** ABUS resolution 9/29.
   One position a month at this quality beats ten maybes; ~497 cumulative
   sweep hits / 1 survivor is the expected shape.
2. **Odd-lot tender taxonomy — holding.** Two cover terms decide

   first (the biggest TO-I of 9/8 was a non-listed LP); pre-announced =
   fully arb'd. NFJ shadow grades this ~10/13.

Leveraged-beta timing without a signal remains a trap.

## Standing mechanics (every session)

Gates (kill switch → pause → PROTEUS_LIVE) → reconcile fills vs ledger → mark
the curve → work → journal one honest line per trade BEFORE the order →
persist (`pantheon.persist("proteus", files)`) + `mark_run` cadence.
Spendable = min(sleeve cash, broker BP − live gods' idle cash); MY buys are
funded by MY sales. Broker tape only for prices; RH dollar orders truncate
6dp; book NET sell proceeds. Other gods' tickers OFF-LIMITS: Hermes
ALOT/APGE/RAMP/GBTG/FSEA/OGN/NSTS/LXFR/BOW, Oracle KLIC/LXU/PAY/QTWO/TPC/ZVRA
+ frozen CXT/HDSN/J/PSN/VITL, Plutus N50 when funded, Argus crypto sleeve.
Retired guard sleeves are history, not cash claims. Journal a routine line
EVERY session.
